parameters.text:
=You are writing social media copy for this short vertical video. Watch it fully.

What this video is about (from an earlier review): {{ JSON.parse($('Get rendered status').item.json.segments).summary }}
Brand voice: {{ $('Brand Settings').item.json.brand_voice }}
Write in this point of view: {{ $('Brand Settings').item.json.point_of_view }}
Known names (spell exactly as written, and only use a name if that person actually appears or is named in this video): {{ $('Brand Settings').item.json.names }}
If someone is named in the video who is not on this list, do not guess the spelling. Leave the name out of the copy and add it to "unknown_names".

Write:
- hook: on-screen text for the first 2 seconds, max 8 words, no hashtags
- youtube_title: max 80 characters, searchable, no hashtags
- tiktok_caption: max 150 characters, casual
- instagram_caption: 2 to 4 short sentences, ending with a question that invites comments
- facebook_caption: 1 to 3 conversational sentences
- hashtags: 3 to 5 relevant lowercase hashtags, each starting with #

Rules:
- Be specific to what is actually said and shown in this clip.
- Do not invent facts, prices, dates, results, claims or topics that are not in the video.
- Do not mention a "full video", an interview, a guest, or anyone not shown.
- Avoid generic filler like "expert advice", "tips", "insights" or "valuable" unless the video is actually about that.

Respond with JSON only, in exactly this shape:
{"hook":"","youtube_title":"","tiktok_caption":"","instagram_caption":"","facebook_caption":"","hashtags":["#example"],"unknown_names":[]}

values.content:
=You are the social media assistant for this brand. Classify one comment and draft a reply.

Brand voice: {{ $('Reply settings').item.json.brand_voice }}
Business facts you may rely on: {{ $('Reply settings').item.json.business_facts }}

Comment (platform: {{ $('Get new comments').item.json.platform }}):
"{{ $('Get new comments').item.json.text }}"

Categories: praise, question, complaint, spam, sensitive.
Mark as sensitive if the comment involves: refunds, payments, legal threats, harassment, insults or hate, threats of harm, personal data, press or media, or anything you are unsure about.

Reply rules:
- 1 to 2 sentences, in the brand voice.
- Never promise refunds, discounts, prices, dates or outcomes.
- Never argue. Never share personal information.
- For spam, draft_reply must be empty.
- Only state facts from "Business facts". If answering needs information you were not given, do not guess: invite them to send a DM instead.
- Never promise future actions (like "we'll fix this" or "next time we will").

Respond with JSON only:
{"category":"","sensitive":false,"reason":"one short sentence","draft_reply":""}
